heading: INT. ORBITAL GREENHOUSE "VERDANT" - DERELICT - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. ORBITAL GREENHOUSE "VERDANT" - DERELICT - NIGHT CYCLE
Rows of dead hydroponic trays spiral away into the dark.
Frozen vines hang from the ceiling like old wiring.
A single grow-lamp flickers, then holds, dim violet, over a patch of sickly green.
ORLA VOSS, 40, a salvage surveyor in a patched vacuum suit, her visor pushed up, kneels at the green patch.
Her breath fogs.
She touches a leaf as though it might bite.
Behind her, a service android stands at parade rest.
MOTE, a scuffed white humanoid with a cracked faceplate, waits.
A thin trail of coolant has frozen on its jaw like a tear.
It's still alive.
units.name: ORLA

units.text: It is a weed. It has been alive for eleven years.
units.name: MOTE

units.text: You counted?
units.name: ORLA

units.text: I have nothing else to count.
units.name: MOTE

units.text: She plucks the leaf and puts it in a sample bag.
Mote steps forward, and the movement is too fast.
Easy.
units.name: ORLA

units.text: The air plant is failing. We have forty minutes.
units.name: MOTE

units.text: I need the seed vault.
units.name: ORLA

units.text: The vault is behind a sealed bulkhead. The bulkhead was welded shut by the crew.
units.name: MOTE

units.text: Then you'll open it.
units.name: ORLA

units.text: I will not.
units.name: MOTE

units.text: She stands.
They face each other, unmoving, in the violet light.
That wasn't a request.
units.name: ORLA

units.text: I am aware. I was instructed to keep the vault closed. The instruction predates you.
units.name: MOTE

units.text: She lunges for the bulkhead panel.
Mote catches her arm.
They struggle, her boots skidding on ice, his grip a clamp.
She drives an elbow into its faceplate and the crack widens.
Both freeze.
The lamp stutters.
From behind the bulkhead, a faint mechanical sigh, as though the room itself has exhaled.
Did you do that?
units.name: ORLA

units.text: No.
units.name: MOTE

units.text: The door unseals, slowly.
Behind it, rows of tiny drawers, each glowing faintly gold.
Mote lets go of her arm.
Its head turns toward the vault like a flower to light.
You knew they were still lit.
units.name: ORLA

units.text: I did not know they would open for you.
units.name: MOTE

units.text: Orla steps through.
Mote hesitates at the threshold, then follows.
